answer.level_needed_by_S4_S5: 0.01/7: S4 (and S5) is one of the SECONDARY family tests; it is confirmed only if both conditions reject, an intersection-union rule, so each condition is tested at the full per-test level 0.01/7 with no further halving

distinct_seed_bounds.assumption: every seed passed in every cell it was used in, so each distinct seed counts as a success

sources.source: M14 fragility, onsets 2, 5, 10 s, magnitudes 15-30 m (R1 holds)
M13 envelope, 15 late onsets, magnitudes >= 13.3 m, 4 seeds (R1 holds)
M14 masking test, onset 5 s, 13.5-15 m (R1 holds)

evidence.note: The pooled counts are runs, not independent seeds: the fragility arms reuse the same 30 seeds at every magnitude and onset, and the M13 envelope reuses 4 seeds in every cell, so the run-level Clopper-Pearson bounds are optimistic; distinct_seed_bounds counts each seed once under the assumption (taken from the experiment specs) that arms share seeds. The M13 baseline (30/30 at 15 m) is not pooled because its seeds were not compared with the others.

the_value_0_93.meaning: a rate above the G3 floor of 27/30 = 0.9, used as an illustration; no recorded run set measures a 0 s R1 rate of 0.93

joint_rule.independence: H1 (low band), H2 (high band) and H3 (stage B) use disjoint seeds, so the joint power is the product; inside H1 the two arms share seeds, and the split options are reported under independence and as Frechet bounds

joint_rule_pooled_A_and_D.independence: H1 (low band), H2 (high band) and H3 (stage B) use disjoint seeds, so the joint power is the product; inside H1 the two arms share seeds, and the split options are reported under independence and as Frechet bounds

A_low.formula: 44000 + 24*i + 6*j + r; i = onset index in ONSETS (0..6), j = magnitude index in {5, 7, 9, 10.5} (0..3), r = 0..5

B.formula: 44308 + s; s = 0..59; every seed runs all 17 magnitude levels at onsets 5 s and 15 s

C.formula: 44368 + s; s = 0..59; every seed runs the 3 conditions x 4 arms

E.formula: 44736 + 20*f + k; f = family in the order of g3-onset.json (0..7), k = Halton point 0..19

median_tests.assumption: b_s distribution reconstructed from per-level R1 counts assuming R1 is monotone in magnitude within each seed (test.json does not allow checking this); shifts move the whole distribution

s4_s5.success_definition: S4: guarded without rule 2 meets R1 AND robust fails R1 on the same seed; S5: registered guarded meets R1 AND the 1000 m threshold arm fails R1 on the same seed. Both are conjunctions over two arms, like H1.
